title: A smoother desktop. A better first start.
summary: Today’s changes bring a more polished desktop, simpler app setup and fixes for the first gaming session.

changes.title: NVIDIA ready for the first boot
changes.text: On supported x64 NVIDIA hardware, installation now builds and checks the driver modules, rebuilds the boot image and updates the rEFInd copy before finishing. Errors stop installation instead of leaving driver setup to the first desktop session. Network access is required.

changes.title: Steam on the desktop and TV
changes.text: Desktop Steam and TV Mode now share the working runtime launcher. Steam stays closed after TV Mode setup, so you can finish its initial update from the desktop. Installation order and error handling have also been checked.

changes.title: One password per Apply
changes.text: InfinitySetup and InfinityUpdater reuse one authorization session when you apply several changes together.

changes.title: A cleaner app grid and search
changes.text: InfinitySetup searches across categories. InfinityConfig drops its unnecessary search bar. Setup and Config keep their own app icons, and dock favorites appear in the app grid.

changes.title: A more useful InfinityTerminal
changes.text: Configurable widgets bring hardware readings, timers, Pomodoro, network transfer, battery, weather and a second time zone together. Monitors can be moved, the layout is centered, and the panel icon follows the theme.

changes.title: A smoother InfinityUpdater
changes.text: The update drawer slides in with a softer animation, keeps controls readable in light and dark themes, and offers a localized restart action when offline updates are downloaded.

changes.title: Desktop details, refined
changes.text: More compact icons and dock artwork, bundled NowPlay and Raccoon Launcher, and fixes for animation behavior and GNOME extension testing.

changes.title: News, right from the live desktop
changes.text: Firefox in the live installer opens this news page. Follow the changelog here as new builds arrive.
